title: The Treaty of Troyes

opening.boundary: Authored late-year cutoff after the stated background developments; not their occurrence date.
opening.label: 15 December 1420 · after the year’s turning points

briefing: The Treaty of Troyes designates Henry V as heir and regent while Charles VI remains king; opposition continues. The treaty's claims coexist with territory and communities supporting the dauphin. Henry's marriage to Catherine and treaty succession are not universal recognition of English sovereignty.
